ledger.claim: The charge stands or falls on the trace, not on the driver's word: the arrival marker on this trip is a driver-pressed 'Im Here' button (trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker = BUTTON), so POL-NS-12's platform-confirmed arrival - which is limited to GPS_AUTO markers - is unavailable, and limb (b) of POL-NS-01 must be carried by the POL-NS-02 geofence test on the exported trace: at least 3 consecutive fixes, each reported at 25 m accuracy or better, inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for this trip, with the waiting clock running from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the tap at 18:06:05, as POL-NS-05 requires. If that test is not satisfied on the trace as the judge runs it, POL-NS-02 entitles the rider to a full refund of the $4.50 cancellation fee.

The rider's one arithmetic route to a refund, the POL-NS-06 shortfall, does not open on this record and the rider does not contend otherwise: the free waiting period in force is 180 s (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, which governs because this record carries platform_policy, not the pre-version-2 zone table), and the derived longest qualifying in-geofence run is 400 s of continuous holding from 18:06:05 to 18:12:45 - a surplus of 220 s, not a shortfall. The rider puts the point no higher than this: only time actually held inside the 50 m arrival radius counts, and time spent outside that radius, or in motion, cannot be added to the 180 s.

The rider does not press POL-NS-04 and does not claim it exonerates him: the chat log holds one message, the driver's ('im at the pickup point', sent 18:06:25, read by the rider at 18:06:55, and carrying no waypoint_hint), the rider sent no locating message of his own and no in-app call was placed, so limb (a) is not met. The rider's silence is not, however, a finding against him, and it does not relieve the driver of proving every limb of POL-NS-01: POL-NS-04 is a rider-exonerating route, and its non-satisfaction is not an element of the charge.

The driver cannot accumulate waiting time across separate in-geofence intervals: EV-ADVIS-02745-01 is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; admissibility weight 0.0, and the rider discloses that impairment) and POL-NS-06(i) requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated, of an admissible type (KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT), before separate in-geofence intervals may be summed - so no advisory on this record can extend the measured dwell beyond the single run the trace shows, and no part of the waiting time can be rescued by limb (i).

The rider's own device recorded 71 stationary fixes averaging 788 m from the pickup pin, and the rider does not dispute that reading - but the rider's distance from the pin is not an element of the charge: POL-NS-01 conditions the fee on the driver's in-geofence dwell, the driver's arrival and the driver's cancellation under a recognised reason code, not on proof that the rider was absent, so the rider's track neither adds to the driver's case nor supplies a fact the driver's own evidence must establish.

The trip record carries the driver's own 'arrived' event for this trip at 18:06:05 on 2026-08-17 ('Driver tapped I'm Here', PLATFORM_TELEMETRY), which satisfies POL-NS-01(a) on the face of the record.

The GPS trace independently places the driver inside the STANDARD arrival radius at the moment of that marker: arrived_at is 18:06:05, dwell_start_offset_sec is 0.0, and 41 fixes qualify inside the 50 m POL-NS-02 radius for this zone class, the closest fix sitting 0.157 m from the pin. That is far more than the three consecutive accuracy-filtered in-radius fixes POL-NS-02 requires, and it satisfies POL-NS-01(b) on the primary route without needing any POL-NS-05 recomputation.

The driver held position inside the geofence in one continuous run of 41 fixes lasting 400 seconds, from 18:06:05 to 18:12:45. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), so the dwell exceeds the required minimum by 220 seconds, and it also clears the stricter 300-second STANDARD figure retained in fee_schedule.minimum_dwell_sec. POL-NS-01(c) is satisfied on either reading.

There is no waiting-period shortfall to excuse the rider: the derived shortfall_sec is -220.0 against the 180-second minimum, i.e. a surplus, so POL-NS-06's premature-cancellation route does not open and no part of the cancellation fee is refundable on that ground.

The trip was terminated by the driver at 18:12:48 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, with no boarding event and no trip start recorded. That is 403 seconds after the arrival event and squarely at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed, so POL-NS-01(d) is met — RIDER_NO_SHOW is one of the three reason codes that limb expressly recognises, and the mis-selection concern in the recorded-outcome cases does not arise.

The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05. The fix matched to the 18:06:05 marker places the driver 0.157 m from the pickup pin, i.e. inside the geofence rather than more than 300 m away, and the trace records no motion at or above 15 km/h at that moment. The 0.0 km/h reading in the trace is the stationary waiting itself, so there is no false-arrival event to record against the driver.

POL-NS-03 cannot rescue the rider. That wrong-entrance route applies only where the driver's stationary fixes lie outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but not more than 400 m from the pin; here the stationary fixes lie inside the radius (minimum distance 0.157 m, all 41 qualifying fixes in-radius), so this is not a wrong-face-of-the-venue case and no refund flows from it.

The rider's own device never came near the pickup point. Across 71 rider fixes the rider_presence summary reports distances from the pin of 784.4 m to 790.5 m, with the mean at 787.7 m, and rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0 against the 100 m STANDARD rider_presence_radius_m. The rider was therefore not at the pin at any point while the driver waited there for six minutes and forty seconds.

The chat log holds exactly one message in the whole waiting window — the driver's own 'im at the pickup point' sent at 18:06:25 — so the rider sent no locating or coordinating message at all and POL-NS-04(a) fails. The rider also read that message at 18:06:55 and neither replied nor came to the vehicle, which is the opposite of the active-coordination conduct POL-NS-04 exists to reward.

No traffic advisory covers this pickup road: EV-ADVIS-02745-01 is MISSING with admissibility status MISSING, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight_multiplier 0.0, so it can carry no fact (POL-GEN-02(3)). The rider cannot use POL-NS-06(i) to accumulate separate in-geofence intervals on the strength of an absent advisory — and the point is academic in any event, because the driver's dwell was one unbroken 400-second run that required no accumulation.

The driver's counterparty statement that he 'was at the pin for over six minutes' is corroborated to the second by two carriers that stand apart from his assertion: the platform's own wait timer (free waiting period started 18:06:07, cancellation at 18:12:48) and the 400-second in-geofence GPS dwell. His in-app message at 18:06:25 putting himself at the pickup point is the third consistent record.

Driver compensation is payable. POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so POL-NS-07 fixes the payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force for this trip — SGD 3.60, the net figure, not the rider's gross figure — which the fare ledger's own driver_compensation block computes at 3.60 under clause POL-NS-07.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip. no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4-or-more limb, and 1 divided by 132 completed_trips_30d is 0.008, below the 0.08 limb; both limbs are required and neither holds, so compensation is paid rather than withheld. These are the only two profile fields POL-NS-07 and POL-GEN-01 permit for this test — the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter is not the field and is not relied on here.

ledger.claim: Fare-line integrity holds and POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged. The ledger's cancellation_fee line of SGD 4.50 equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50, which is the figure fee_schedule.resolution_rule produces for this record, and the ledger reconciles to total_charged of 4.50; nothing in the fare breakdown contradicts the charge or makes it impaired as a carrier of the amount.

No escalation trigger is present. The rider's no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) do not fire, and no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence — the trip record, the GPS trace and the chat log agree to the second — so POL-NS-09(b) does not fire either. This case should be decided on its merits, with the fee standing and the driver's payout made, not held.

Every artifact carrying the deciding facts is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0: the 10-second trace runs at 100.0 percent coverage with zero gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0 and both tracks present; the trip record is causally ordered; the chat log's sequence numbering is intact and the ledger reconciles. No POL-NS-08(a) to (d) impairment applies and no POL-GEN-02(2) cap depresses confidence in the ruling.

ruling.explanation:
Rider and driver: this dispute is decided on the record, without a human reviewer.

Outcome. The $4.50 no-show cancellation fee charged to the rider stands and is not refunded, and the driver is paid $3.60 compensation.

Why the fee stands — POL-NS-01 requires four things, and all four are on the record. (a) The trip record carries the driver's own 'arrived' event at 18:06:05 on 17 Aug 2026. (b) The exported GPS trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at that moment: 41 fixes qualify, the closest 0.16 m from the pin, well beyond the three consecutive accuracy-filtered in-radius fixes POL-NS-02 requires. (c) He held position in one continuous run of 400 seconds, from 18:06:05 to 18:12:45, against the free waiting period of 180 seconds in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec) — a surplus of 220 seconds. (d) He terminated the trip at 18:12:48 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, with no boarding event, which is after the required dwell elapsed. The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05: at 18:06:05 the driver was 0.16 m from the pin and stationary, not more than 300 m away and not travelling at 15 km/h or above, so the waiting clock legitimately runs from that fix.

What each side argued. The rider is right that POL-NS-12 cannot assist the driver here — this trip's arrival marker is a driver-pressed BUTTON, and POL-NS-12 covers only GPS_AUTO arrivals. That point is accepted but immaterial, because the POL-NS-02 geofence test is satisfied on the exported trace itself. The rider is also right that POL-NS-06 does not open: 400 seconds is a surplus against the 180-second minimum, not a shortfall, so no refund flows from premature cancellation. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: the only message in the chat log is the driver's, sent 18:06:25, so the rider sent no locating or coordinating message and limb (a) fails. POL-NS-03 does not apply either — the driver's stationary fixes were inside the arrival radius, not outside it but within 400 m — so this is not a wrong-entrance case. The driver's alternative reference to the 300-second fee_schedule.minimum_dwell_sec does not govern a record that carries platform_policy, as this one does; the governing minimum is 180 seconds, and 400 seconds clears either figure.

Rider's own position. The rider's device recorded 71 stationary fixes averaging about 788 m from the pin, outside the 100 m rider-presence radius. That reading is not disputed and is not used against the rider: the rider's distance is not an element of the charge, which turns on the driver's arrival, dwell and cancellation. It simply means POL-NS-04 cannot help him.

The missing traffic advisory. EV-ADVIS-02745-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and, under POL-GEN-02, can carry no fact; the absence is itself noted. It is not needed here: the driver's 400-second hold was one unbroken run, so no accumulation of separate in-geofence intervals under POL-NS-06(i) is required.

Driver's pay. POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full, and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's compensation at 80 per cent of the $4.50 fee in force — $3.60, the net figure, which is also what the fare ledger computes. The anti-farming check does not trip: one no-show termination in the trailing 30 days (below 4) at a rate of 0.008 (below 0.08), and both limbs must hold. The ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and amount_sgd carries the same $3.60 as the compensation figure; the rider's own $4.50 charge is unaffected and the two are not netted.

Evidence quality and confidence. Every artifact carrying a deciding fact is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0: the 10-second trace at 100 per cent coverage with zero gaps and both tracks present, the causally ordered trip record, the chat log with intact sequence numbering, and the ledger reconciling to $4.50. No POL-NS-08(a) to (d) impairment applies, no artifact below 1.0 carries a deciding fact, and no POL-NS-09 escalation trigger fires, so confidence is 0.95. The money effect of $3.60 is below the $8.00 execution threshold and is executed automatically. No clause of this policy directs a referral on these facts, so none is issued.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
